title: The code and the new password
assertion: The code step is a sealed sign-in step that states 15 minutes, warns at two in its own words and closes at its limit; the policy is checked before the provider; a wrong, expired, used, replaced or over-tried code and an unknown address get one refusal on the code field, with the code and both passwords emptied; a wrong code counts no failure and locks nothing; the confirm counts in `sign_in` by the sealed address and a changed address is refused without the provider; Send a new code opens the step again without typing and shows its own refusals, and Use a different email ends it at any time, with the address not kept; the dev twin holds the code hashed, for an hour, single use, five tries
noFileReason: The local identity provider mails its reset codes to a synthetic outbox the tests read, and the step timer runs on a clock the test moves; no file.
